card.name: Alle-Pia Calabrese salamini
card.description: Calabrese salamini from Alle-Pia on the Central Coast. Slice thin, bring out bread and cheese, and let the table fill up slowly.

meet_the_maker.name: Alle-Pia
meet_the_maker.story: Alle-Pia brings old-world Italian family recipes to the Central Coast, making small batches of cured meat under chef Antonio Varia’s direction. Cut a few thin slices. Add bread, cheese, maybe a tomato. You have the beginnings of a meal that needs very little explaining.
